title: Duke and the Cube
lines: Ben has one cute mule, Duke.
Once, Duke sat in the dust.
He will not get up at all.
"Up, Duke!" said Ben. The mule just sits.
Ben gets a cube of yam from a tube.
He hums a tune and lifts up the cube.
Duke gets up fast and grabs the yam.
Then they step up the path and go home.

questions.ask: What does Duke do when Ben tells him to get up?
questions.listenFor: Nothing - he just sits. The line says "The mule just sits."

questions.ask: What finally gets Duke up on his feet?
questions.listenFor: A cube of yam out of the tube. If they say "the tune," that is close - ask what Ben lifted up as he hummed.

questions.ask: What do you think Ben will take next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. Listen for something like "yam, because that is what got Duke moving."
